XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sporadic jerky operation under heavy acceleration, with engine failure warning light coming on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0380 | FITTING | TUBING | PIPE | DUCT | PUMP | LOW | PRESSURE | FUEL | DIESEL | TANK | START | PART | ACTIVATE | TURN ON | TURN OFF | IMMEDIATELY | AFTER |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Component: Low-pressure fuel pump to tank connection

  • Fault: Occasionally, when the engine is warm, the engine starts on the first attempt but stalls immediately. On the next start attempt, the engine starts normally and runs.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P0380 (Glow Plug Timing Control 1 - Malfunction)

  • Cause: Fuel low-pressure pump to tank connection damaged

• Action: Check the condition of the low-pressure fuel pump-to-tank connection and replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The pump is located under the driver’s side floor mat and can be accessed by removing the metal cover via the inspection hatch.
